answer_1.quote: We propose a novel generation framework, DYPLOC (dynamic planning of content), to conduct content selection and ordering as text is produced ... Our model is end‑to‑end trained ... We experiment with the tasks of argument generation and opinion article writing ...

answer_2.quote: We report results on test sets with standard automatic metrics: BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR ...

answer_4.quote: We hire three proficient English speakers to evaluate four key aspects of the generated outputs: grammaticality, coherence, relevance, content richness ...
answer_4.guideline: Each aspect is rated on a scale of 1 (worst) to 5 (best).
